args.body:
File: docs/API.md

Document the validation limits on report fields (name max 120 characters, category names max 60 characters and at most 50 categories, schedule recipients at most 20) in the API reference under Reports.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API reference does not document the field limits for reports (name length, category count and length, schedule recipient count), so we are adding them to `docs/API.md`.
